doc.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003

title: Jack Crystal and the Central Plaza
summary: Jack Crystal admitted him cheaply to the Central Plaza; Billy Crystal wants the ticket stub.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: brother-in-laws — but he got out of the Commodore Music Shop. And he was nice to me. Jack Crystal was nice to me. And Billy Crystal liked that, and Dick Schaap liked that because it was so odd, and Bernhardt, he can’t believe, I’m the only guy he meets who doesn’t know his famous nephew and does know his late brother.
Oh really. But your father liked the fact that you had all these associations with these musicians.
